title: Anyone used sorceress.games and is it good?
author: levy608
selftext:
I saw in their pricing they have a $49 one time payment for lifetime. Seems to good to be true!!

Wondering if anyone has used the tool, and has any pros/cons from it?

comments.author: Inevitable_Stop9298
comments.body: Maybe is a huge redflag, token cost a recurring so that businesses model is completely unsustainable longterm

replies.author: levy608
replies.body: Thats what I was thinking, how is that viable

comments.author: Square-Yam-3772
comments.body:
it is not that worth. 

the problem with these tools is that they are getting outdated already. 

the general AI models are getting regular upgrades 

the one-time fee pitch is clever though (but they are basically saying they dont expect you to sub for more than 2-3 months so they rather just take the lump sum)

replies.author: levy608
replies.body: thanks! yeah I was trying to research if they were better than the other models but does not look like it.  That is such a great call out on their pricing lolol

replies.author: Square-Yam-3772
replies.body:
nah, those tools were created 1-2 years ago when AIs are still iffy to work with

to achieve a decent result in the past, you have to have some custom setup with comfyUI and pass the data round in some convoluted flow (or run a bunch of command lines in their server)

some people figured out how to do that and they basically offer it as a service. 

in today's world (since last month or so), you can just prompt AI directly and get really good results. 

so yeah, some of these tools are a thing in the past.

replies.author: levy608
replies.body: Awesome thanks for saving me 50 bucks!
